input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2 obliges the Company (our party) to pay HDI a stipulated sum whenever we terminate, computed as half of twelve months' Net Sales above $800,000 and payable in eight quarterly instalments. That is a Customer-payable liquidated amount that is uncapped and untethered to fees, so it fails the fallback (early-termination fee capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount). Rather than delete the whole mechanic — which would leave the Section 4 heading and subsections (b) and (c) dangling — we take the fallback: new Section 4.2(d) characterises the Termination Payment as an early-termination fee, makes it our sole liquidated amount, and caps it at three months of Section 3.1 fees. The formula, zero-floor and instalment mechanics in (a)–(c) are preserved and operate subject to the cap.

mappings.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.

proposal.summary: Cap the Company's Termination Payment at three months' fees as its sole liquidated amount.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.2 requires us to pay HDI a stipulated sum on termination calculated off twelve months of Net Sales, which is an uncapped liquidated amount payable by us. We have added Section 4.2(d) to confirm the Termination Payment is an early-termination fee, is our sole liquidated amount, and is capped at three months' fees, consistent with our fallback position.

ops.text: The Termination Payment is an early-termination fee and is the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company under this Agreement, and shall not exceed the aggregate fees payable by the Company to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) calendar months preceding the Termination Date.
